RBC Direct Investing periodically verifies external bank accounts that have been linked for pre-authorized deposits, automatic contribution plans, or withdrawal instructions. Our records indicate that a linked external account on your profile is due for verification. This is a standard security measure.

If verification is not completed, pre-authorized transfers to and from this linked account may be paused. This verification protects you to ensure no unauthorized external accounts are attached to your investment profile.

What does verification involve?
Log in to your RBC Direct Investing account, navigate to your linked accounts settings, and confirm that the external account information on file is correct. If any details have changed, you can update your account information at the same time.

Verify linked account now
